liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a larger share of the cash balance is customers' prepayments.
The group launched a cash tender offer on existing bond tranches and announced its intention to issue new bonds to refinance part of its existing debt.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow of {{fcf@FY2024}} compares with {{fcf@FY2023}} in FY2023, and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2024}}.
Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}), as cash and cash-like investments declined.
Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2024}}, a sensitivity if bookings slow.
Investment: capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2024}}, so capital spending absorbs a larger share of earnings than at peers.
